## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

Python API or bindings (`cudnn.torch`, the PyTorch SDPA provider)

## Summary

The `cudnn.torch` overrides of `torch_attn::_varlen_attn`, `_varlen_attn_out` and `_varlen_attn_backward` now honor the backend that `varlen_attn` selected. Where the ops take a trailing `backend` argument, an override serves a call only if it selected cuDNN and `_varlen_supported` admits it. Every other call goes to the kernel the override replaced, which is torch's own op body. Torch versions without the argument behave as before.

## Why

Since pytorch/pytorch#193631, `varlen_attn` picks flash or cuDNN from `sdpa_kernel` and the SDPA priority order, and passes the choice to these ops as a trailing `backend` argument. The overrides were written before that and take no such argument, so on current torch they break both ways:

- **cuDNN selected:** the dispatcher passes `backend` and the override raises `TypeError` (forward, out and backward).
- **Flash selected:** `backend` is at its default, so the dispatcher leaves it out and the override runs anyway. Calls inside `sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION)` get cuDNN whenever the config is one the python path supports.

A review of pytorch/pytorch#195981, which adds `torch.backends.cuda.enable_cudnn_sdp_python` on top of `install_sdpa_overrides()`, found this. Accepting and ignoring the argument would fix the exception but not the routing.

How the calls are passed on: before registering each override, `install_sdpa_overrides()` captures the op's current CUDA kernel with `torch.library.get_kernel` and registers the override `with_keyset=True`. Calls the override doesn't serve go back to that kernel with `call_boxed`, the pattern the `get_kernel` docs describe. That kernel is torch's op body, which runs flash or torch's C++ cuDNN path as selected. So a cuDNN call that the python path declines (for example with `seqused_k`) stays on cuDNN rather than dropping to flash, and the provider doesn't copy any of torch's dispatch logic.

## Related issues

Related to pytorch/pytorch#195981 (review comment on the varlen backend contract).

## API and compatibility impact

- No public API change. `install_sdpa_overrides()` keeps its signature and handle.
- **Torch with the `backend` argument:** torch also decides which configs can select cuDNN for varlen, and its rules admit only full or causal windows. Sliding-window and right-bounded calls therefore go to flash, and the provider no longer serves them there. They can only reach the python path once torch's selection admits them.
- **Torch without the argument** (2.13 and earlier nightlies): unchanged. Every varlen call is served here as before, sliding windows included.
- `calls` gains `fwd_torch` and `bwd_torch`, counting varlen calls passed on to torch.

## Testing

- New `test/python/sdpa/torch/test_torch_provider_backend.py` (L0; skips where the ops have no `backend` argument):
  - cuDNN selected: served, forward and backward.
  - Flash selected: passed on to torch, with output bitwise-equal to the same call without the overrides.
  - `varlen_attn_out` follows the selection both ways.
  - A cuDNN-selected `seqused_k` call (which the python path declines) runs torch's C++ cuDNN path, per torch's own log line, and not flash.
- `test_torch_provider.py`: the varlen tests select cuDNN explicitly and skip the windows torch rules out of cuDNN.

On H100:

| torch | result |
|---|---|
| 2.15.0.dev20260923+cu130 (has `backend`) | `test_torch_provider_backend.py`, `test_torch_provider.py`, `test_torch_provider_lifecycle.py`: 30 passed, 4 skipped (the sliding windows above) |
| same, provider without this change | the 5 new tests all fail |
| 2.14.0.dev20260616+cu130 (no `backend`) | 29 passed; the new file skips |

```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<H100> PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python python -m pytest -q \
  test/python/sdpa/torch/test_torch_provider_backend.py \
  test/python/sdpa/torch/test_torch_provider.py \
  test/python/sdpa/torch/test_torch_provider_lifecycle.py
```

These ran against a dev cuDNN 9.29 build before rebasing onto current develop. The rebase touched none of these files.

files.patch:
@@ -41,8 +41,9 @@
 _lib: Optional[torch.library.Library] = None
 
 # Observability for tests: how many aten calls the bridge served on the
-# python API vs fell back (cpp = C++ worker ops; fa2 = flash varlen kernels).
-calls = {"fwd": 0, "bwd": 0, "fwd_cpp": 0, "bwd_cpp": 0, "fwd_fa2": 0, "bwd_fa2": 0}
+# python API vs fell back (cpp = C++ worker ops; fa2 = flash varlen kernels;
+# torch = varlen calls passed to torch's own op body, see _honoring_backend).
+calls = {"fwd": 0, "bwd": 0, "fwd_cpp": 0, "bwd_cpp": 0, "fwd_fa2": 0, "bwd_fa2": 0, "fwd_torch": 0, "bwd_torch": 0}
 
 
 def _fwd(
@@ -141,6 +142,13 @@ def install() -> None:
 # level up instead: override the `torch_attn::_varlen_attn{,_backward}`
 # custom ops at the CUDA key. Their autograd wiring is untouched; unlike the
 # dead branch we also serve GQA and causal sliding windows.
+#
+# Later torch versions give these ops a trailing `backend` argument: the
+# backend varlen_attn selected from sdpa_kernel and the SDPA priority order.
+# There the overrides honor it (_honoring_backend): a call runs here only if
+# it selected cuDNN and _varlen_supported admits it. Every other call goes to
+# the kernel the override replaced, torch's own op body, which runs flash or
+# the C++ cuDNN path as selected.
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 
@@ -276,6 +284,52 @@ def _varlen_bwd(grad_out, query, key, value, out, lse, cu_seq_q, cu_seq_k, max_q
     return dq, dk, dv
 
 
+def _serves_varlen_fwd(call) -> bool:
+    ws = _norm_window(call.get("window_size"))
+    return _varlen_supported(ws, call.get("seqused_k"), call.get("block_table"), call.get("num_splits"))
+
+
+def _serves_varlen_bwd(call) -> bool:
+    return _varlen_supported(_norm_window(call.get("window_size")))
+
+
+# (op, implementation, the calls it serves, counter for the calls it passes on)
+_VARLEN_OVERRIDES = (
+    ("_varlen_attn", _varlen_fwd, _serves_varlen_fwd, "fwd_torch"),
+    ("_varlen_attn_out", _varlen_fwd_out, _serves_varlen_fwd, "fwd_torch"),
+    ("_varlen_attn_backward", _varlen_bwd, _serves_varlen_bwd, "bwd_torch"),
+)
+
+
+def _has_backend_arg(op) -> bool:
+    args = op._schema.arguments
+    return bool(args) and args[-1].name == "backend"
+
+
+def _honoring_backend(op, serve, serves, counter):
+    """Wrap ``serve`` so that it runs only for calls that selected cuDNN and
+    that ``serves`` admits; every other call goes to the kernel being replaced.
+
+    Call before registering the override: it captures the CUDA kernel in
+    effect now (torch's own op body) as the one to pass calls on to.
+    """
+    names = [a.name for a in op._schema.arguments]
+    default = op._schema.arguments[-1].default_value
+    replaced = torch.library.get_kernel(op, "CUDA")
+    cudnn_backend = torch.nn.attention.SDPBackend.CUDNN_ATTENTION.value
+
+    def impl(keyset, *args, **kwargs):
+        # The dispatcher leaves out trailing arguments that equal their
+        # default, `backend` among them when flash is selected.
+        call = dict(zip(names, args), **kwargs)
+        if call.pop("backend", default) == cudnn_backend and serves(call):
+            return serve(**call)
+        calls[counter] += 1
+        return replaced.call_boxed(keyset, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    return impl
+
+
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 # Installing the overrides
 #
@@ -314,18 +368,22 @@ def install_sdpa_overrides() -> SdpaOverrides:
 
     Overrides the CUDA kernels of ``aten::_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention``
     and its backward, and of ``torch_attn::_varlen_attn``,
-    ``_varlen_attn_out`` and ``_varlen_attn_backward``. Returns the handle that
-    removes them.
+    ``_varlen_attn_out`` and ``_varlen_attn_backward``. Where the varlen ops
+    take a ``backend`` argument, their overrides serve only calls that
+    selected cuDNN. Returns the handle that removes them.
     """
     lib = torch.library.Library("aten", "IMPL")
     lib.impl("_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention", _fwd, "CUDA")
     lib.impl("_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward", _bwd, "CUDA")
     vlib = torch.library.Library("torch_attn", "IMPL")
     from torch.nn.attention import varlen as _varlen_mod  # noqa: F401 — ensure torch_attn ops are defined
 
-    vlib.impl("_varlen_attn", _varlen_fwd, "CUDA")
-    vlib.impl("_varlen_attn_out", _varlen_fwd_out, "CUDA")
-    vlib.impl("_varlen_attn_backward", _varlen_bwd, "CUDA")
+    for name, serve, serves, counter in _VARLEN_OVERRIDES:
+        op = getattr(torch.ops.torch_attn, name).default
+        if _has_backend_arg(op):
+            vlib.impl(name, _honoring_backend(op, serve, serves, counter), "CUDA", with_keyset=True)
+        else:
+            vlib.impl(name, serve, "CUDA")
     return SdpaOverrides(lib, vlib)

@@ -39,6 +39,13 @@
 import torch.nn.functional as F  # noqa: E402
 
 import cudnn.torch as provider  # noqa: E402

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""The varlen overrides honor the backend varlen_attn selected.
+
+Later torch versions pass that choice to the ``torch_attn`` varlen ops as a
+trailing ``backend`` argument. The provider serves a call only if it selected
+cuDNN and the cuDNN python path supports it; everything else must reach torch's
+own op body: flash when flash was selected, torch's C++ cuDNN path otherwise.
+"""
+
+import logging
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+    pytest.skip("CUDA device required", allow_module_level=True)
+
+try:
+    from torch.nn.attention import SDPBackend, sdpa_kernel
+    from torch.nn.attention.varlen import varlen_attn, varlen_attn_out
+except ImportError:
+    pytest.skip("torch.nn.attention.varlen with varlen_attn_out required", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from cudnn.torch import sdpa_provider  # noqa: E402
+
+if not sdpa_provider._has_backend_arg(torch.ops.torch_attn._varlen_attn.default):
+    pytest.skip("this torch's varlen ops take no backend argument", allow_module_level=True)
+
+FLASH = [SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION]
+CUDNN = [SDPBackend.CUDNN_ATTENTION]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def overrides():
+    handle = sdpa_provider.install_sdpa_overrides()
+    yield handle
+    handle.remove()
+
+
+def _inputs(lens=(128, 256), H=4, D=64):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    lens_t = torch.tensor(lens, device="cuda")
+    cu = torch.nn.functional.pad(lens_t.cumsum(0), (1, 0)).to(torch.int32)
+    T, mx = int(cu[-1]), int(lens_t.max())
+    q, k, v = (torch.randn(T, H, D, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda", requires_grad=True) for _ in range(3))
+    return q, k, v, cu, mx
+
+
+def _calls_since(before):
+    return {key: n - before[key] for key, n in sdpa_provider.calls.items() if n != before[key]}
+
+
+def _attn(backends, **kwargs):
+    q, k, v, cu, mx = _inputs()
+    before = dict(sdpa_provider.calls)
+    with sdpa_kernel(backends):
+        out = varlen_attn(q, k, v, cu, cu, mx, mx, window_size=(-1, 0), **kwargs)
+    out.backward(torch.ones_like(out))
+    return out, _calls_since(before)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_selected_cudnn_is_served(overrides):
+    _, served = _attn(CUDNN)
+    assert served == {"fwd": 1, "bwd": 1}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_selected_flash_is_passed_to_torch(overrides):
+    out, served = _attn(FLASH)
+    assert served == {"fwd_torch": 1, "bwd_torch": 1}
+    overrides.remove()
+    expected, _ = _attn(FLASH)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backends, expected", [(CUDNN, {"fwd": 1}), (FLASH, {"fwd_torch": 1})], ids=["cudnn", "flash"])
+def test_out_variant_honors_the_selection(overrides, backends, expected):
+    q, k, v, cu, mx = _inputs()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        out = torch.empty_like(q)
+        before = dict(sdpa_provider.calls)
+        with sdpa_kernel(backends):
+            varlen_attn_out(out, q, k, v, cu, cu, mx, mx, window_size=(-1, 0))
+        assert _calls_since(before) == expected
+        with sdpa_kernel(backends):
+            ref = varlen_attn(q, k, v, cu, cu, mx, mx, window_size=(-1, 0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=0, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_selected_cudnn_config_the_python_path_declines_runs_torchs_cudnn(overrides, caplog):
+    # The cuDNN python path does not serve seqused_k; torch's C++ cuDNN path
+    # does. The call must stay on cuDNN rather than drop to flash.
+    q, k, v, cu, mx = _inputs()
+    seqused_k = (cu[1:] - cu[:-1]).to(torch.int32)
+    before = dict(sdpa_provider.calls)
+    with torch.no_grad(), sdpa_kernel(CUDNN), caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="torch.nn.attention.varlen"):
+        varlen_attn(q, k, v, cu, cu, mx, mx, window_size=(-1, 0), seqused_k=seqused_k)
+    assert _calls_since(before) == {"fwd_torch": 1}
+    assert "Using cuDNN backend for varlen_attn" in caplog.text
